description: fmt.Fprint* and io.WriteString into writers that are not the HTTP response stay clean: a strings.Builder or bytes.Buffer declared without an initialiser and passed by address, a &bytes.Buffer{} literal, an io.Writer formal, os.Stderr / os.Stdout, and json.Marshal output written to the response.

expected.notes: var sb strings.Builder is an in-memory buffer
var buf bytes.Buffer and &bytes.Buffer{} are in-memory buffers
an io.Writer formal is a stream, not the response
encoding/json escapes <, > and & in string values
os.Stderr / os.Stdout are never the response
os.Stderr / os.Stdout are never the response
